description.en: Original Ctenocystis-inspired low flattened bilateral plated theca with a curved marginal frame, quiet paired dorsal fields and naturally seated anterior blade-like ctenidium comb. Stemless basic form, no crab legs, Cothurnocystis boot rescale, exact plate counts, Conollia-specific details or feeding/locomotion reconstruction.
